sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Size, shape and colour almost identical to Parrhinotermes aequalis, but the pilosity slightly denser and more seta-like, the setae longer. The fontanelle groove slightly more distinct than in aequalis. Antenna 13-segmented, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2. Labrum slightly longer than in aequalis, inconspicuous. Mandibles not geniculate as in aequalis and inaequalis, only strongly curved; their apical part much shorter than half the total mandible length. Left mandible with 2 median teeth almost equal in size (in aequalis the outer tooth is much larger than the inner); right mandible with a small median tooth (very large in aequalis). Anterior margin of the pronotum slightly upturned, both anterior and posterior margins slightly concave. Measurements: body length 3.25 mm; head length (mandibles closed) 1.56 mm; head length (excluding mandibles) 1.10 mm; head width 0.91 mm; pronotum width 0.53 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Morphologically almost indistinguishable from P. aequalis, but slightly larger. Antennal segment 3 equal in length to segment 2 or slightly shorter (in aequalis segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2). Measurements (this species / aequalis): body length 3.3—3.5 mm / 3.4—3.5 mm; head width 1.03 mm / 0.87—0.95 mm; pronotum width 0.57 mm / 0.46—0.49 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: There is also a pair of ergatoid reproductives (worker-like reproductive individuals): both sexes pale and rather small, but the female with a markedly distended abdomen; thoracic segments wide and flat, most like the thoracic segments of the soldier; head of worker type, with a fontanelle gland and very small pale compound eyes, without ocelli; transverse band and mouthparts as in the alate. Antenna 13-segmented in the male and 14-segmented in the female, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2 in the male and the reverse in the female. Anterior margin of the pronotum weakly concave. Measurements: body length 3.5 mm in the male, 9.5 mm in the female; head width 0.99 mm; pronotum width 0.65 mm; abdominal width of the female 2.28 mm. Localities: Taiping and Maxwell's Hill, Malacca; Bandar Baroe, Sumatra (1 June 1912 (month 6), collected together with the ergatoid reproductives). It lives in holes in half-dry trees and in very wet rotten wood, the holes filled with wet clay and containing numerous galleries. Krishna and Adams 1982 added a description of the alate from the lectotype colony: head yellow to pale yellowish brown, with 3 pale rounded spots arranged in a triangle between the ocelli; postclypeus, anteclypeus and labrum cream-white; antennae pale yellow; pronotum cream-yellow to pale yellow; wing scales brown, wings and legs pale yellow. Measurements: head capsule length 0.46—0.47 mm; head length (to the postclypeus) 0.41—0.43 mm; head width 0.61 mm; compound eye diameter 0.21—0.22 mm; maximum pronotum length 0.33 mm, width 0.46—0.50 mm; hind tibia length 0.56 mm; fore wing (from the suture) length 5.90 mm, width 1.52 mm.

note: The original description was published as Parrhinotermes buttel-reepeni, with the soldier, the worker and the ergatoid reproductives all included; the alate was first described by Krishna and Adams 1982 from the lectotype colony. Holmgren's original is in German and was taken from the OCR of the Internet Archive library scan.
